parsed.rationale: Both `MockHLSAVPlayer.play` and `MockPlayer.play` reside under test-support paths (`Shared/Playback/Tests/HLSPlayerTests/` and `Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTestUtilities/Mocks/`) within the `Playback` package. Although the context flags report `is_test: false` and `is_mock: false`, the file paths and type names (prefixed `Mock`) make clear these are test-double implementations of distinct player protocols. A `play()` method with an empty signature is the minimal required stub for any player mock, so the structural coincidence is inherent to the domain contract rather than a sign of unintended duplication. Consolidating them into a shared base would couple two independently scoped mock hierarchies without meaningful benefit.
